description: A small stack of four nested plastic bowls sits on the bed in front of you. The left hand reaches forward to steady the bowl stack while the right hand grips the top orange bowl and lifts it off to the right, then the left hand lifts the next light purple bowl toward you and sets it down; next the right hand pulls the dark gray bowl out and places it near the others, leaving the remaining light blue bowl on the bed as both hands withdraw.
